verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs say a project can be viewed as a table, a kanban board, or a timeline-style roadmap, and saved views can be shared with the team. That covers board, list (as table) and timeline views of the same work, but the evidence never mentions a calendar view. Missing for 10: a documented calendar view, explicit confirmation that the table layout serves as the list view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of switching between layouts.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work

citations.quote: You can view your project as a high-density table layout, as a kanban board, or a timeline-style roadmap.
You can save these views, allowing you to quickly return to them as needed and make them available to your team.
